params.body:
School management (school admins and the superadmin, who already see the usage page) needs to see how many scores each teacher enters, including who has not started. Two more things make that list usable: which classes a teacher teaches, and leaving out staff who keep the teacher role but do not teach.

## Per leerkracht on the usage page

A per-teacher list existed from 30 September to 1 October 2026 (177ab33e) and was replaced by "who works in a class, after a click" (036f6c4a), because it sets colleagues side by side. That comparison is what management now needs, so the list comes back next to the per-class view.

- **Who is listed:** every teacher of the school, with the scores they entered themselves in the window, the evaluations they made, the date of their last score and the classes they are linked to. Teachers who entered nothing are listed with a grey zero. Anyone else who entered a score or made an evaluation at the school is listed too, marked "geen leerkracht van de school" (or shown as "Verwijderd account"). The rows plus the unattributed scores therefore add up to the Scores headline, and a test checks that sum.
- **Sorting:** by name by default. A click on a column header sorts on the server: figures and dates start from the most, names from A, and a second click reverses the order. Ties keep name order. The headers carry `aria-sort`.
- **Scores without a name:** a score knows who entered it only since 30 September 2026 (R S3-7.4). The page always says so under the table, with the number of unattributed scores in the window. When the window starts on or before that day and such scores exist, the number is also shown above the table, next to the figures. This applies to the running school year, where a zero would otherwise read as "entered nothing".
- **Cache:** remembered like the other parts, under `teachers.2`. The old `teachers` key still holds closed years in another shape. `naviskore:usage-warm` warms it.

## Teachers of a class

- **Card:** the class page gets a Leerkrachten card next to Klascoach. An admin of the school, or a superadmin, searches the school's teachers and links them. The links live in `student_group_teacher` with `coach = 0`, the table the klascoach already uses.
- **Klascoach:** the klascoach is one of the class's teachers. Taking someone off as klascoach already kept them linked. `addCoach` on someone already linked now promotes that row instead of adding a second one.
- **Access:** a link grants no access; only the usage page reads it. The card checks who is acting on open and on every action.
- **On the usage page:** each teacher's classes appear in Per leerkracht. An opened class also lists linked teachers who have entered nothing there yet ("gekoppeld aan deze klas, nog niets ingegeven").

## Marked as no teacher

- **The mark:** `school_staff.counts_as_teacher` (default true). On the staff form an admin ticks "Geen leerkracht op <school>" for the school selected at the top. The role and what it allows stay, and the staff page shows the mark as a badge.
- **Form:** the form always sends the field (a hidden 0), so a save without it changes nothing.
- **Effect on the usage page:** the school's teachers are the accounts with the teacher role linked to the school, less who it marked (`UsageAnalytics::teachers`). The headline and the per-teacher list share this definition.
- **Leerkrachten actief:** now counts only those teachers, so it never exceeds its total. Until now any account that made an evaluation counted, an admin too. The headline moves to `headline.4`.

## Access to the usage page

Each usage part now accepts only a superadmin, or an admin linked to the school selected at the top. Until now a part checked the role only and relied on the session middleware for the school. Teachers and pupils get a 403 on the page and on each part.

## Rules

- New: R B8-1.4, R B8-2.5, R B8-2.6, R B8-2.7, R B9-2.1, R B9-2.2.
- Updated: R B8-2.1, R B8-2.3, R B8-3.1, R B8-3.2, and the B8 intro.
- Typing `Offering::studentGroups` removes one PHPStan baseline entry.

## Deploy

- One migration: `2026_10_26_120000_a_school_can_say_someone_is_no_teacher`, which adds the `counts_as_teacher` boolean to `school_staff` with default true.
- Closed years recompute the headline on first look (`headline.4`). `php artisan naviskore:usage-warm` warms them.

## Tests

- **New test files:** `TheUsageCountsPerTeacherTest`, `TheTeachersOfAClassTest`, `SomeoneMarkedAsNoTeacherTest`, plus new cases in `TheUsageShowsWhoWorksInAClassTest` and `TheUsagePageLoadsInPartsTest`.
- **Mutation check:** 69 of 70 hand-made mutants are killed. The survivor removes the check in `sortTeachers`; `render` asks the same question, so the request still ends in a 403. The old code fails 8 usage tests.
- **Full suite:** 1399 passed, 20 failed, all in the workbench baseline (Chrome/PDF, archiving, build stamp). PHPStan clean.
params.title: Usage per teacher for school management, teachers of a class, and a no-teacher mark
